skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract proper or improper fractions that already have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract proper or improper fractions with different denominators by first rewriting them with a common denominator.

skills.name: Mixed or whole subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers, whole numbers, or fractions from mixed numbers when the minuend's fractional part is sufficient after any needed denominator matching.

skills.name: Mixed or whole subtraction with regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers, whole numbers, or fractions when a whole must be renamed as fractional units before subtracting.
